theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet M → Measurable f → Measurable G → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → ∀ q : Euclid P → ℝ, Measurable q → ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * ENNReal.ofReal |q x| ∂μHE[n + 1] ≠ ∞ → (∀ᵐ t, IntegrableOn q (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) μHE[n]) ∧ Integrable (fun t => ∫ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, q x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫ t, ∫ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, q x ∂μHE[n] = ∫ x in M, ‖G x‖ * q x ∂μHE[n + 1]
